text:
deploy-bot: deploy complete: release/2026.3.20-rc5 -> prod us-west-2. traffic shift started (canary 5% -> 25%). running post-deploy fallback-ratecheck synthetic now.
laura: noticing small spike in 5xx on the embed probe, p95 latency +120ms in the first minute.
kevin: which probe id? paste the probe line if you have it.
anita: fetching probe logs from host pool...
ops-bot: /probe fetch --id embed-fallback-ratecheck --window 60s
marc: logs snippet:
````
ERR 503 backend-usw2-2 connection reset
probe: prefix_hit=0.88 prefix_miss=0.12 latency_ms=430 p95_ms=520
````
jess: hmm looks like a transient backend dropout. not a full rollback-worthy signal yet but we should limit blast. propose pin traffic at 25% and wait 3m.
laura: agree. hold at 25%, bump the synthetic alert threshold to avoid noisy pagers (mute for 5m) and annotate the rollout.
kevin: action: deploy-bot set-traffic release/2026.3.20-rc5 25% (reason: postdeploy probe variance).
deploy-bot: done — traffic pinned to 25% until 2729990036. comment: "hold for probe stabilization"
anita: I'll spin a targeted canary of previous variant (release/2026.3.19) on a tiny subset and run dark-compare for the probe to see divergence.
marc: decision rule: if 5xx_rate > 1% after 3m -> rollback to 2026.3.19. If < 0.5% continue ramp.
jess: also add a one-retry in the synthetic counting rule (retry once before marking failure) to reduce flip-flop on transient network blips.
laura: creating incident annotation and adding runbook steps in #incidents, tagging oncall @anita. link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2729990001
anita: trace added:
````
trace-id: abc123-service
service: embed-proxy
span: outbound -> backend-usw2-2
metric: 5xx_rate=0.9%
````
kevin: update: after pin and canary of previous variant, 5xx dropped to 0.3% and p95 returned near baseline. recommendation: resume ramp to 100% after 10m stable window.
laura: agreed. schedule ramp in 10m, keep synthetic on extended window for 30m.
deploy-bot: scheduled auto-ramp to 100% at 2729990090 (can be canceled by oncall).
jess: will add a short note to the release notes: "minor transient probe variance observed during us-west rollout; mitigated by staging traffic hold and retry tweak to synthetic. no customer impact observed."
laura: thanks all — keeping thread open until 30m mark then will close. :white_check_mark:
